question: What are the client id and birth date of the client named 佐藤 花子?
reply:
```sql
SELECT "client_id", "birth_date" 
FROM people.client 
WHERE "full_name" ILIKE '佐藤 花子';
```

```sql-unbound
SELECT "client_id", "birth_date" 
FROM people.client 
WHERE "full_name" ILIKE :name;
```
